Name: CS_EFFECT_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Visual effect (particle) settings for each level of the Effects Quality option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The lowest level used is Low, so the first row is never applied. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 3.

Fields.Name: Soft Particles Enabled
Fields.Description: Off disables soft particles (particles fading out where they meet surfaces).

Fields.Name: Effect Glow Enabled
Fields.Description: Off disables the glow of effects.

Fields.Name: Bilateral Upscale Mode
Fields.Description: Bilateral upscale of effects drawn at reduced resolution: 0 follows the scene's setting, 1 forces it off, 2 forces it on.

Fields.Name: Particles per Emission Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the number of particles an effect emits at once, clamped to 0.5–1.

Fields.Name: Emission Interval Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the time between emissions; higher means fewer emissions. Values below 1 count as 1.

Fields.Name: 1st LOD Distance Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the distance at which effects switch to their first LOD stage.

Fields.Name: 2nd LOD Distance Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the distance at which effects switch to their second LOD stage.

Fields.Name: 3rd LOD Distance Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the distance at which effects switch to their third LOD stage.

Fields.Name: 4th LOD Distance Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the distance at which effects switch to their fourth LOD stage.

Fields.Name: Reduced Buffer Distance Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the distance used to decide whether an effect is drawn to the reduced-resolution buffer.
